notes.spec_basis: STU-RAS-033 (merge bracketed exposures to HDR with ghost removal and tone-mapping; tone-mapping 32/16/8; 32-bit beyond display range), STU-RAS-149 (depth capability metadata; typed refusal naming depth and supported set; no silent promotion), STU-RAS-044 (native on-device offline), STU-RAW-129 (names only; HDR edit mode not in this lane)
notes.push_hold: lead instruction: commit slices locally, after the green bundled run write HOLD_FOR_RELEASE with the green local sha; push only after RELEASE
notes.readings_declared: merge: Debevec-Malik 1997 hat on the largest channel over (black 1/512, clip 0.98), linear-light weighted mean of z/relative_exposure, zero-weight pixels -> longest unclipped exposure else shortest clipped; align: Ward 2003 MTB translation-only, each frame to the reference, exclusion band median/16 (paper: +-4/255 on gamma grey), bounded by max_shift 1..64 and an 8-sample coarsest level; deghost: anchor = reference sample when weighted else weighted sample nearest its exposure, levels 1/2/3 = 1, 1/2, 1/4 stop, inconsistent pixel takes the anchor radiance; tone-map: 2^ev exposure, Reinhard 2002 eq.4 on Rec.709 luminance (prism grade::LUMA_REC709), hue-preserving scale, prism DisplayEncoding srgb/bt1886/gamma22 (PQ refused), round(v*(2^depth-1)); develop: merge in normalised demosaiced camera space (develop's cfa_plane + demosaic_normalized_threads; 1.0 = white level so the clip test is exact), EXIF ExposureTime as seconds, equal f-number and ISO required, then the reference bracket's DngRaw::recipe (BaselineExposure ignored) as-shot gain + camera->working matrix (same arithmetic as stage A)
notes.unverified: Photoshop Merge to HDR Pro / HDR Toning and Lightroom Photo Merge > HDR (auto-align, deghost amounts, presets): D5, no oracle
notes.not_proven: Photoshop/Lightroom HDR parity (no D5 oracle); real camera brackets (develop tests synthesise DNG brackets of one linear scene)
notes.sources: Debevec & Malik, Recovering High Dynamic Range Radiance Maps from Photographs, SIGGRAPH 1997; Ward, Fast Robust Image Registration for Compositing HDR Photographs from Hand-Held Exposures, JGT 8(2) 2003; Reinhard, Stark, Shirley, Ferwerda, Photographic Tone Reproduction for Digital Images, SIGGRAPH 2002 (papers only, no code read)
notes.public_api: additive only: new pigment module hdr_merge (+ align, tone submodules), new develop module hdr_merge; no existing signature changed, no new dependency or edge
notes.slice4_signature: OUT OF THIS LANE (lead 2026-10-30: follow-up lane).
